name: Rotate spin
summary: Spiral-wedge transition: a coloured sector sweeps round the centre like a clock hand, covering or clearing the frame.

params.name: mode
params.note: in covers the frame by spinning, out clears it

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
